text:
julia: Heads-up: support flagged a cluster of reconnects where HTTP/2 -> WS upgraded clients lose resume headers during the 101 upgrade and end up billed twice. Seen across EventSource and WS clients.

omar: Confirmed in traces. Upgrade path shows headers dropped on the proxy side for some clients. Example: 
```
[12:31:10.000] EDGE: upgrade start ctx=gw-21
[12:31:10.090] EDGE: client handshake headers: sec-websocket-protocol=redwood-stream; x-client-fp=fp-21  # no x-resume-token
```

rachel: Console currently treats them as separate sessions so UX + billing both look bad for customers. Support got one escalated ticket.

julia: Quick mitigations brainstorm: (1) edge keepalive pings to avoid idle-close for upgrade-proxied flows, (2) runtime tolerant-merge for very short reconnects if fingerprint+auth match, (3) console grouping with "merged-reconnect" badge.

omar: (1) is easiest short-term but increases our infra cost. (2) is risky security-wise. (3) is UI-only and helps perception but doesn't solve billing.

trace-bot: Trace hint: attach tag `upgrade_path=htt2-ws` to stream-open events when upgrade flow used. Helps filter.

rachel: For console grouping: show collapsed row, aggregated tokens, and a small "merged by heuristic" tooltip linking to raw events. Default collapsed.

julia: Billing proposal: if reconnect B is within 2s of A AND same auth-subject AND same client-fingerprint AND tokens(B) < 75 AND runtime emitted `resume_failed`, then mark B as "provisional-merge" and issue a credit. Emit event `billing_action=provisional_merge`. Need legal signoff.

omar: We'll emit runtime events: `resume_attempt`, `resume_failed`, `chain_probe` so billing & console can trust the signal. Add trace attribute `resume_header_present=<true|false>`.

rachel: Also add a support button "audit raw events" to grouped rows so CS can inspect both opens/closes.

julia: Short-term: enable edge keepalive for tenants in cohort `upgrade-heavy` for 72h while we canary header passthrough fix.

billing-bot: I'll create alert: if provisional_merge credits > 0.2% of billed tokens in 24h trigger investigation.

omar: Edge fix: make proxy preserve non-standard headers across upgrade and add integration test that asserts `x-resume-token` present on handshake. Canary Wed 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Plan recorded: proxy header fix -> canary Wed 02:00 UTC, rollout Fri 04:00 UTC; runtime telemetry patch -> Thu 08:00 UTC; console grouping -> next sprint.

julia: Action items: omar -> proxy passthrough + test; rachel -> console mock + audit button; billing-bot -> RFC + alert; julia -> coordinate support cohort and enable keepalive pilot. Sync tomorrow morning in #eng-platform.

trace-bot: incident-note INC-2026-623 created: "upgrade-path header loss causing transient duplicate sessions" (severity: low)
